cards.ex: You want to leave early? Fair enough, you finished all your work.
cards.exUz: Erta ketmoqchimisan? Yaxshi-ku, sen barcha ishlaringni tugatding.
cards.uzDef: Bu kelishuvga loyiqmi yoki yo'qmi degan ma'noni anglatadi. Rozi bo'ldingizmi?

cards.ex: So, add the sugar last, got it?
cards.uzDef: Tushundingizmi, xabaringiz bormi degan savol. Ma'lumotni qabul qildingizmi?

cards.ex: No more mistakes, are we clear?
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsa tushunarlimi? Hech qanday savol yo'qmi? Deyish uchun.

cards.ex: I saw you arguing, what's the deal?
cards.exUz: Men sizning bahslashayotganingizni ko'rdim, nima gap?
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat nima ekanligini so'rash. Muammo nima?

cards.ex: I explained it twice, does that compute now?
cards.exUz: Men ikki marta tushuntirdim, endi tushunarlimi?
cards.uzDef: Bu narsa mantiqan to'g'rimi? Tushunishga qulaymi? degan ma'noda.

cards.ex: Free tickets? What's the catch?
cards.uzDef: Bu yaxshi bo'lish uchun nimadir yashiringanmi? Qandaydir yomon tomoni bormi?

cards.ex: A million dollars? Sounds too good to be true.
cards.uzDef: Bu narsa juda yaxshiki, unda yolg'on bo'lishi mumkinmi?

cards.ex: You seem quiet, are you having second thoughts?
cards.uzDef: Qaroringizni o'zgartirish haqida o'ylayapsizmi? Shak-shubhangiz bormi?

cards.ex: I'm packed, ready when you are?
cards.exUz: Men yuklarimni yig'dim, qachon tayyor bo'lsangiz?
cards.uzDef: Siz tayyor bo'lganingizdan keyin boshlashga tayyormanmi?

cards.ex: Just hear me out before you judge.
cards.uzDef: Mening fikrimni oxirigacha eshiting. Shoshilmang.

cards.ex: Don't be late, get my drift?
cards.uzDef: Nimani nazarda tutayotganimni tushundingizmi? Ma'noni angladizmi?

cards.ex: You seem down, what's eating you?
cards.exUz: Siz xafa ko'rinasiz, nima bezovta qilyapti?
cards.uzDef: Sizni nima tashvishga solmoqda? Nega xafa ko'rinasiz?

cards.ex: It's 2 AM, are you still awake?
cards.uzDef: Hali ham uyg'oqmisiz? Uxlash vaqti emasmi?

cards.ex: Follow the rules, is that clear?
cards.uzDef: Bu tushunarlimi? Savollar bormi?

cards.ex: Will it rain tomorrow? Who's to say?
cards.exUz: Ertaga yomg'ir yog'adimi? Kim ayta oladi?
cards.uzDef: Buni kim aniq aytishi mumkin? Hech kim bilmaydi degan ma'noda.

cards.ex: Volunteers needed, any takers?
cards.uzDef: Bu ishni qilishni xohlovchilar bormi? Kimdir qiziqadimi?

cards.ex: I apologized, are we good now?
cards.uzDef: Bizda muammo yo'qmi? Hamma narsa yaxshimi?

cards.ex: The computer isn't working. Have you tried turning it off and on again?
cards.exUz: Kompyuter ishlamayapti. Siz uni o'chirib qayta yoqishga harakat qildingizmi?
cards.uzDef: Siz oldin shu usulni qo'llab ko'rdingizmi? Shu yo'lni sinab ko'rdingizmi?

cards.ex: Slow down, what's the rush?
cards.uzDef: Nega shunchalik tezlashyapsiz? Hech qayerga shoshilmasak ham bo'ladi-ku?

cards.ex: It was a small mistake, does it really matter?
cards.exUz: Bu kichik xato edi, haqiqatan ham farqi bormi?
cards.uzDef: Bu muhimmi? Farqi yo'qmi?

cards.ex: He's not interested, can you get a clue?
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tushunib yetdingizmi? Biror narsani anglab oldingizmi?

cards.ex: We could go to the beach. How's that sound?
cards.exUz: Biz sohilga borishimiz mumkin. Qanday eshitiladi?
cards.uzDef: Bu sizga qanday taklif bo'lib ko'rinadi? Sizga yoqadimi?

cards.ex: You look upset, what's the story?
cards.uzDef: Nima sodir bo'ldi? Voqeani aytib beringchi?

cards.ex: We're voting now, any objections?
cards.exUz: Biz hozir ovoz beramiz, e'tirozlar bormi?
cards.uzDef: Bu taklifga qarshi bo'lganlar bormi? Kimdir norozi emasmi?

cards.ex: You said it was bad, care to elaborate?
cards.exUz: Siz yomon dedingiz, batafsil ayta olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Buni yanada batafsil tushuntirib bera olasizmi? Qo'shimcha ma'lumot bera olasizmi?

cards.ex: Free food and music, what's not to like?
cards.exUz: Bepul ovqat va musiqa, nimasi yoqmaydi?
cards.uzDef: Bu yaxshi, nimasi yomon? Deyishga arziydigan narsa yo'q.

cards.ex: Sorry, I got distracted. Where were we?
cards.uzDef: Suhbatimiz qayerda to'xtagan edi? Nimani gaplashayotgan edik?

cards.ex: Did I mention the party is tomorrow?
cards.exUz: Men partiya ertaga ekanligini aytib o'tdimmi?
cards.uzDef: Men buni eslatib o'tdimmi? Bu haqida gapirdimmi?

cards.ex: Everyone's laughing, what am I missing?
cards.uzDef: Men tushunmayotgan nimadir bormi? Muhim narsani bilmayapmanmi?

cards.ex: He won the lottery, fancy that!
cards.uzDef: Bu qiziq emasmi? Shunga ishonasizmi? Ajablanarlimi?
